statement: For positive weights and positive-definite component norms, Dq_A_norm=0 is equivalent to componentwise zero for A in {X,Z}.
proof: sum_i w_i||partial_A q_i||^2=0 with w_i>0 implies partial_A q_i=0 for every i.
consequence: This forbids cancelling a source/readout leak against geometry or EM by signs.

statement: Strict quotient absence requires five separate zeros: geometry, source/readout, clock/marker, boundary/projector, and EM/Poynting.
proof: Dq[partial_A]=(partial_A G_obs,partial_A M_obs,partial_A Theta_obs,partial_A B_obs,partial_A EM_obs).
consequence: Geometry-only verticality is insufficient for coupling/local-GR claims.

statement: If any component derivative is nonzero or unsigned, A in {X,Z} cannot be promoted to an absent quotient fibre for local tests.
consequence: The branch moves to J_A/Dq leak coefficient rows instead of another theorem-zero pass.
